paper_metadata.title: Regulation of strength and ductility of single-phase twinning-induced plasticity high-entropy alloys

evidence.quote: Near-equiatomic single-phase twining-induced plasticity (TWIP) high-entropy alloys (HEAs) exhibit a good combination of strength and ductility
Face-centered cubic (FCC) single-phase CoCrFeMnNi and CoCrFeNi HEAs exhibit a good combination of strength and ductility at various temperatures
